The '''Keldrath sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
[[File:Keldrath_sector.jpg|thumb|left|220px|The Keldrath sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The region was discovered during the expansion of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot's]] [[Xim's empire|empire]] circa [[25,100 BBY]]. It later formed the [[Keldrath Alignment]], one of the many fiefdoms that formed from the remnants of Xim's empire. The Keldrath Alignment disappeared when the cluster joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. The region was integrated into the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] during the [[Old Republic era]].<ref name="Xim Week" />

The sector was created on the same area as the Keldrath Alignment when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] split the Tion Hegemony into multiple sectors.<ref name="Xim Week" />
